name: University of New York in Prague

scholarships.name: Scholarship & Financial Aid Guidelines
scholarships.description: Applicants must apply for and receive approval for all merit scholarships, awards, and tuition discounts

scholarships.name: Scholarship Fund
scholarships.description: CZK 500,000 annually, divided equally between the Fall and Spring semesters.

scholarships.name: Award Amount
scholarships.description: CZK 15,000 for the top 30 students with the highest GPA from the previous semester. In the event of a tie, overall GPAs will be reviewed. Grading revisions must be completed within four weeks after the semester’s grading deadline.

scholarships.name: Graduate Discount
scholarships.description: Graduates of any UNYP program who enroll in another degree program at UNYP receive: A CZK 50,000 one-time tuition fee waiver An application fee waiver

scholarships.name: Certificate Discount
scholarships.description: UNYP Bachelor’s and Master’s alumni pursuing additional courses for certificates in new areas/specializations are eligible for: A 50% discount on the tuition for specific courses This discount also applies to Master’s students taking Bachelor’s-level courses for certificate purposes.
